body.title: chore(deps): bump the rust-minor-patch group with 2 updates
body.body:
Bumps the rust-minor-patch group with 2 updates: [tempfile](https://github.com/Stebalien/tempfile) and [clap](https://github.com/clap-rs/clap). Updates `tempfile` from 3.26.0 to 3.27.0
Changelog

Sourced from tempfile's changelog.

3.27.0

This release adds TempPath::try_from_path and deprecates TempPath::from_path.
